datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 per official Zenodo metadata; code separately MIT
datasets.scope: Complete Mocap, Gaze and AudioGazeGBack modalities from official Dataset.zip; all session/participant files retained. Not complete multimodal ZIP: audio, words and prosody deliberately excluded.
datasets.format: 60Hz frame-level TXT joint Euler rotations and gaze pitch/yaw; session-level CSV speaking/gaze/nod/shake labels. Not a ready-to-use BVH rig.
datasets.capture: ViconIQ optical mocap; synchronized physical clapboard; published processing includes gap interpolation and smoothing.
datasets.fit: Auxiliary three-party body-response/attention and listener behavior, not evidence of walking intersections or crowds. Speech-related production may shape motion even when previewing silently.
limitations: Rig hierarchy/offset mapping and detailed joint coverage require preprocessing documentation before retargeting.
Missingness and identity/time alignment not yet independently validated from the downloaded motion matrices.
No perceived-status labels; conversational state and relation are not status ground truth.
datasets.validation: ZIP64 central directory parsed (357 entries). Selected entries fetched by byte range, decoded, checked against per-entry CRC32 and byte length, SHA256 and line counts recorded. Full-archive MD5 cannot be claimed when selecting entries.

datasets.scope: Complete 8-minute session body keypoints and calibration; no multicamera videos requested.
datasets.format: COCO19 synchronized 3D reconstructed body points with confidence and per-person IDs; no local joint rotations or articulated rig.
datasets.license: Official database research-only/noncommercial; preserve terms before later use.
datasets.fit: Natural negotiation groups/formation and nonverbal responses; no guarantee of locomotion crossing coverage.
limitations: Markerless multiview reconstructed points, not optical marker mocap fidelity.
Occlusion, missing joints/frames and person-ID continuity must be screened before animation.
Not acquired; no claims about file size or actual per-frame completeness.

datasets.format: 20 body 3D keypoints; roughly167k frames, 3–6 people, five settings: park/street/indoor/special/complex crowd.
datasets.access: Official page states pure IMU part publicly downloadable via Baidu; synthetic part requires signed data access agreement emailed to authors. No agreement signed or email sent.
datasets.download_issue: Official Baidu link not accessible by current web fetch; no credentials/CAPTCHA/alternate mirror bypass attempted.
datasets.license: Dataset-specific terms not fully verified; MIT code license is not a dataset license.
datasets.fit: Closest of this group to mobile multiperson interaction but sparse 20-keypoint skeleton will not preserve subtle hands/shoulders; IMU/synthetic portions must not be conflated.

excluded_this_round: LISI-HHI is dyadic and overlaps the dedicated dyadic search; not separately downloaded.
conclusion: Group data acquired/downloading are not status ground truth; prioritize actual movement data from other tracks for cross-action expression tests, retain Multi-TPC for later response studies.
